title: POWERFUL! But the battery system is weird
text:
POWERFUL! But the battery system is weird. This product is super strong and perfect for moving large quantities of leaves. I've tried a few battery operated blowers before, and honestly they were never strong enough compared to their plug in or gas powered counterparts. The 453cfm rating on this one made me take notice, and I have to admit that this is the FIRST battery operated unit that I can confidently say is strong enough to replace a corded or gas option.
However, in order to achieve this, the unit requires 2 batteries. They are loaded up in tandem on the left and right of the back of the blower, and it requires both of them to be charged in order to work. This is a bit of an odd design, but I guess in order to reach the whopping amount of power necessary here, one battery pack isn't enough. The box comes with both necessary batteries, however it only comes with a single charger capable of charging only ONE battery at a time! This is a major downside. At full power, these batteries can easily run out of charge within 20-30 minutes. And then you have to charge not just one, but wait for it to finish and then charge the second battery! This is very frustrating and begs the question of why didn't they just include a charger for each battery?
If you get this blower, I strongly recommend buying a second charger, and perhaps a second set of batteries to swap. That would make it perfect. As of now, it's close but not quite what I could be.
